refnamediv.refpurpose: Return the filter coefficients of a Blackman-Harris window defined by Nuttall of length m.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: w = nuttallwin(m) w = nuttallwin(m, "periodic") w = nuttallwin(m, "symmetric")

listitem.para: Positive integer specifying the length of the window.
(optional) String specifying the type of window. Possible values are:
Returns the periodic form of the window (equivalent to a window of length m+1 with the last coefficient removed).
Default behavior if no second argument is provided.
Vector containing the Nuttall window coefficients.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `nuttallwin` function computes the coefficients of a Blackman-Harris window as defined by Nuttall. The window is of length `m`. If the optional argument `"periodic"` is provided, the periodic form of the window is returned. If `"symmetric"` is provided or no second argument is specified, the symmetric form of the window is returned.
